verdict.rationale: PlanetScale docs describe 'PlanetScale Bot' (Grok-powered) that helps users understand performance and fix queries via its MCP server and skills, plus 'self-improving database' agents that review Insights and open PRs — evidence of an assistant-like agentic feature tied to the product. However, most of the agent tooling (Claude, Cursor, custom agents) is external/BYO via MCP rather than a single first-party in-console assistant, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the bot's actual behavior. Missing for 10: independent verification of PlanetScale Bot in use, clearer distinction between built-in vs bring-your-own-agent, and UI/UX evidence of the assistant embedded directly in the product console.
